text: Bed 12 day one after laparoscopic appendectomy for acute appendicitis. Now increasing site pain, nausea, and mild re redness around the entire dressing. Denies active bleeding and vomiting. No known drug allergy. Acute appenditis. No suspected surgical site infection. Temperature 100.2 degrees Fahrenheit. Blood pressure 124/78 mmHg, pulse 98, saturation 97 on room air. IV fluids. Pyacetamol as prescribed. Continue ceftriaxone, wound review and blood count. Diet,sp to soft diet, cur rice, dull water. No oil fed. General, keep dressing dry. Breef supported walks. Report high fever, bleeding or worsening pain. Review this evening.
